Margaret Helm (centre): in the plate she staggers, leaning back against Black Partridge, her head turned, her right arm reaching across to the warrior, her dress falling in folds to the rock with a cloak loose behind; the render is an upright figure in a smooth cone of skirt with her arms out to the sides [T-3582: re-posed on this picture: leaning back against Black Partridge, the right arm across to the warrior's waist, the left hand back at Black Partridge's chest, the hair in a knot, the skirt falling to the rock and the cloak hanging from the right arm; the folds themselves are T-3583's]

Black Partridge (behind her, right): in the plate his left arm is raised high and out to the upper left with the palm open against the blow, his head in a headdress with a long feather streaming back, the musket slanting down past his right side; the render raises a straight arm ending in a long bar and carries a stick at his right, without the open hand, the headdress or the musket's shape [T-3582: re-posed on this picture: the left arm raised high and out to the upper left ending in an open hand, the feather standing from the headband and the long one streaming back, the right arm round Mrs. Helm, the musket slanting from behind the left shoulder past the right hip to its butt, the stride to the right]
